intro.text: A reclusive mathematics professor invited to the governor's spring dinner at Lady ZoBell's penthouse in 342 PC.
A reclusive mathematics professor and scientist known for advances in combustion technology, invited to the governor's spring dinner at Lady ZoBell's penthouse in 342 PC.

items.text: Sophi Tarcsel says Hanlanaze stole her father's research on incandescent lights and took the credit for the designs that came into wide use.

Hanlanaze, a known recluse, was on the guest list for the governor's dinner and address at Lady ZoBell's, but had answered that he might not come. The guest list noted that no one else could use his ticket, yet Wayne got in by posing as him.

appearance.text: Bearded and fairly heavyset, and at least part Terris.
